concept.hr: Mreža otpornika smanjuje snagu za zadane dB, a na oba kraja ostaje 50 Ω
concept.en: A resistor network lowers the power by set dB and keeps 50 Ω at both ends

summary.hr: Odaberite prigušenje, oblik Pi ili T i niz otpora: stranica izračunava idealne otpore, najbliže standardne i prigušenje koje oni stvarno daju.
summary.en: Pick the attenuation, a Pi or T shape and a resistor series: the page calculates the ideal resistors, the nearest standard ones and what they really give.

what.hr: Aplet applet_daempfungsglied.html i tekst odjeljka o prigušnim članovima (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_daempfungsglied.html and the text of the attenuator section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, preveden na engleski, dodani shema sklopa, ulazni otpor i snaga, klizač do 40 dB, formule bez KaTeX-a
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, translated into English, a circuit drawing, the input resistance and power added, the slider up to 40 dB, formulas without KaTeX
